For a 50-person Indian company, Trip.com/flights is primarily an online flight marketplace, so its economics differ from a full managed-TMC contract. Current public pricing is mostly fare-dependent rather than a fixed corporate subscription. Trip.com says it covers 680+ airlines and offers app/member discounts. 
Trip.com

Provider	Current price model	Exclusions / watch-outs	Best fit
Trip.com	Airfare + applicable taxes/fees; no published corporate subscription	Corporate policy/approval workflows and negotiated-account pricing may require separate arrangements; cancellation/reissue costs depend on fare	Teams wanting broad international flight inventory and self-service
MakeMyTrip myBiz	Booking/travel cost; corporate pricing generally quote/transaction-based	Verify service fees, cancellation/reissue, GST invoicing and support SLA	Indian companies prioritising domestic travel and GST controls
FCM Travel India	Custom quote	Implementation, transaction fees, after-hours support and cancellation/reissue charges must be contracted	Companies wanting a managed TMC with human support
Amex GBT / Egencia	Custom quote	TMC fees, implementation, payment terms and some inventory limitations	Companies needing global travel management and stronger enterprise controls

Purchase test: request each provider's 12-month all-in quote for 50 travellers, including 100/250/500 bookings, GST, amendments, cancellations, after-hours support and implementation. Public sources do not provide apples-to-apples current totals, so any exact “annual price” would be misleading.
